_comment: The game's sound bank: every effect of the original, one entry per cartridge id (`rom`) — what its scripts and code ask for — and its file, that id's entry of the original's sound test (`npm run sound-test`, assets/audio/sfx/<id>.wav). A name is what it is and its id, `sfx_<id>` while nobody has said what plays it; `label` is for a person and the editor's picker. Every gain is one number: the files keep the levels the game plays them at. Voices are not here — they belong to a fighter, in data/entities/<name>/sounds.json.
